name: Bumper Mines
design_intent:
MAYHEM MILE 11 (tier 2) — pinball meets landmines. The flagship three-island / one-void shape studded with FOUR non-lethal BUMPER obstacles (two tall gap posts + two floating cube bumpers) that ricochet careless arcs, plus ONE proximity LANDMINE on each SIDE island (A and C). The combo: get pinballed by a bumper and the mine is right there -- read both. Reuses static bumper-tier platforms (non-lethal reflect, refunds fuel) + the shipped Bomb landmines (inner-radius kill(&ring_out) + outer knockback). kill_shape void_is_floor -> QA K1'.

DOCTRINE FIT (§2.0): (1) LETHAL/NON-LETHAL split -- bumpers NEVER kill (elastic reflect only); the two mines instakill inside kill_radius via kill(&ring_out) + a radial knockback. No new death path/scorer. (2) TELEGRAPHY -- bumpers are solid painted obstacles you read on sight; each mine shows a pulsing trigger ring and an expanding warning ring over telegraph_lead 0.9s before it blows. (3) FAIRNESS -- bumpers are placed SYMMETRICALLY about x2030 and never fully block a required crossing (they narrow lanes, not seal them); the two mines sit at the CENTRE of side islands A/C, symmetric, each >= 300px from every spawn (outside the 170px trigger ring). Island B is a permanent clear refuge. (4) CREDIT -- a mine kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall; a rival pinballed/knocked onto a mine within 6.0s is credited by the ring-out window. No environment scorer.

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship void_is_floor): three trampoline islands A x0..900 / B x1580..2480 / C x3160..4060, all top y1080, 680px void gaps. Bumpers: two TALL girder POSTS (w100 h420) standing in the two void gaps at x1190..1290 (A<->B) and x2770..2870 (B<->C), tops at y620 -- pinball pillars you thread past mid-boost (they never seal the 680 gap, just add a ricochet body); two floating CUBE bumpers (130x130) flanking B at (1680,700) and (2350,700). MINES at A centre (450,1030) and C centre (3610,1030): proximity, trigger_radius 170, kill_radius 150, blast_radius 300, telegraph_lead 0.9, recur 6.0. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>= 650px recovery sky). VOID READS AS DEATH via pit_void_rendering. Deep-space palette (stars on) = a scrap belt.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; trampoline apex 270 => ~395px drift; spring 480 => ~527px max drift; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680 in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (x900..1580 = 680 over void, with a bumper post mid-gap): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; the post is a non-lethal ricochet you thread past (touching it reflects + refunds fuel, never kills), miss the gap = fall. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..3160 = 680, mirror post): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the mines on A/C: step outside the trigger ring / clear the 0.9s warning ring. Verb: DODGE (+ READ).
- The cube bumpers over B redirect vertical fights but never seal footing; zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap: flight is REQUIRED. No bumper creates a bounce path across a gap (a reflect off a post still lands you short of 527px without boost).

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the first level mixing pinball BUMPERS with lethal MINES (bumper_gauntlet is bumpers-only, minefield mines-only). One-sentence read: 'thread the pinball posts across the gaps and don't get ricocheted onto a side-island mine.'
